overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Web Form : 4D.WebForm'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented 4D.WebForm return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a 4D.WebForm proxy object emulating the current Qodly page's properties and functions, each of whose properties is a 4D.WebFormItem object.

constraints: The 4D.WebForm object is a proxy, not a direct reference to the web form: it does not expose all Page properties (e.g. in the Debugger).
Returns null if called in a request that does not originate from Qodly Studio.
